title: Stage 1: Set Up Your Free Work Environment
subtitle: Before anything else, install the tools you need to build and view your website.

steps.desc: This is where you will open your project and write code.
steps.action: Download free from cursor.com or code.visualstudio.com

steps.desc: Once VS Code is open, go to Extensions and install 'Live Server' so you can see your website update in real-time.
steps.action: Install via VS Code Extensions tab

steps.desc: Runs server and frontend dev tools on your computer.

title: Stage 2: Understanding The Core Concepts (ELI5)
subtitle: Learn how web apps work using simple everyday analogies.

steps.title: 1. What is Frontend?
steps.desc: Everything visitors see and click on—buttons, forms, pages in client/src/pages/ and components in client/src/components/.

steps.title: 2. What is Backend?
steps.desc: The server engine processing requests in server/src/controllers/ and business logic in server/src/services/.

steps.title: 3. What is a Database?
steps.desc: Permanent data storage managed in database/schema.sql and database/migrations/.

title: Stage 3: Prepare Your 5 AI Context Briefing Docs
subtitle: Fill the 5 markdown files inside the context/ folder before prompting AI.

steps.title: 1. context/PRD.md (Product Requirements)
steps.desc: Defines what your website does, target user roles, and MVP features for launch.

steps.title: 2. context/ARCHITECTURE.md (System Flow)
steps.desc: Defines layered architecture conventions (controllers -> services -> database).

steps.title: 3. context/SCHEMA.md (Data Blueprint)
steps.desc: Defines database table schemas and API endpoint contracts.

steps.title: 4. context/DESIGN.md (Design System)
steps.desc: Defines colors, fonts, spacing, and component styling rules.

steps.title: 5. context/RULES.md (Coding House Rules)
steps.desc: Defines naming conventions, DRY/KISS principles, and error handling rules.

title: Stage 4: Scaffold Your Project Structure
subtitle: Create an empty folder, open it in VS Code, open the Terminal, and paste a scaffolding script.

steps.title: Why You MUST Setup Folder Structure First
steps.analogy: Building a House Foundation & Rooms Before Buying Furniture
steps.desc: If you ask AI tools to write code without a clean folder structure, AI will scatter files randomly. Setting up client/, server/, and database/ upfront gives AI a clear room for everything.

steps.title: Open VS Code Terminal
steps.prompt: Create an empty folder on your desktop. Drag and drop it into VS Code. Click 'Terminal' > 'New Terminal' at the top menu.

steps.title: Run Scaffolding Script
steps.prompt: Scroll down to the 'AI Setup' section of this guide, select your OS, copy the Folder Scaffolding Script, and paste it into your VS Code terminal. Hit Enter!

title: Stage 5: Prompt AI to Build Your Code Step-by-Step
subtitle: Use the Prompt Builder below, then copy/paste into Cursor or Claude!

steps.title: Initialize The Master System
steps.prompt: Use the Master System Initializer Prompt (from the section below) and paste it into AI. Ensure you attach your 5 context files so the AI understands your project.

steps.title: Build Master Database Schema
steps.prompt: Based on context/SCHEMA.md, ask AI to generate database/schema.sql containing clean DDL SQL queries to create all database tables and insert sample test records.

steps.title: Build Reusable UI Components
steps.prompt: Refer to context/DESIGN.md. Ask AI to build reusable UI components in client/src/components/ (Button, Modal, Table, Navbar, Card).

steps.title: Build Backend Controllers & Services
steps.prompt: Ask AI to implement API routes in server/src/routes/, HTTP handlers in server/src/controllers/, and business logic in server/src/services/.

title: Stage 6: Deploy Live to Vercel & Railway (Free)
subtitle: Publish your full-stack site online!

steps.title: 2. Deploy Frontend on Vercel
steps.desc: Connect GitHub to vercel.com to host your client/ frontend for free.

steps.title: 3. Deploy Backend & DB on Railway
steps.desc: Connect GitHub to railway.app to host server/ and database/ MySQL/Postgres for free.
